name: Nahiri
description: Nahiri is an ancient kor lithomancer and planeswalker from Zendikar who built the hedron network that imprisoned the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: After her spark ignited she landed on Innistrad, where Sorin took her under his wing, and later she joined Sorin and Ugin in a plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citations.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nahiri pulled the hedrons from the earth over forty years while Ugin etched them, and the three activated the network at the Eye of Ugin, then Sorin and Ugin left while she stayed as jailer.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: When vampires disrupted the prison she woke, called for help in vain, and restored it alone; angry at Sorin, she went to find him, and he sealed her in the Helvault.

citations.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

bio.text: Freed when the Helvault shattered, she found Zendikar ravaged and swore vengeance on Sorin, wrecked Markov Manor, and summoned Emrakul to Innistrad with cryptoliths.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: She defeated Sorin and encased him in stone before leaving Innistrad.

"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Back on Zendikar she took the Lithoform Core, killed Zareth with it and pushed Akiri off a ledge, until Nissa used the Core to heal the plane and Nahiri planeswalked away furious.

citations.text: "Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She joined the strike team to New Phyrexia and, infected by phyresis, hid it before cleaving the Coliseum onto the Fair Basilica, after which Elesh Norn compleated her.

bio.text: As a compleated evangel she returned to Zendikar and fused herself into the Emeria Skyclave, until Tazri's party broke her loose and the Skyclave crashed with her inside.

bio.text: Cured of compleation but with her spark lost, she refused Ajani's offer to atone together and vowed no planeswalker would set foot on Zendikar again.

timeline.summary: Nahiri desparks Ob Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: desparks Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisons Nahiri inside it.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decide to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi; Ugin helps imprison them on Zendikar instead.
timeline.quote: Ugin told them that it wouldn't be a good idea to destroy them and instead helped them imprison the Eldrazi on the plane of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Three against three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic and Nahiri's hedron network forms the prison bars.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane, directing their hunger to that unique mana

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok, and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Even after Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise and build a hedron and leyline network on Zendikar to trap the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers combine their magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedron network, sealing the Titans in stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers seal the Eye with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath, then disband.
timeline.quote: Their mission complete, the planeswalkers disbanded.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine near the Eye, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri awakens, calls for help in vain, restores the prison alone, then leaves to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own, and restored the prison.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a trap network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes on Zendikar, with Nahiri building it and Ugin inscribing runes.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's spark ignites and she lands on Innistrad, where Sorin decides to mentor her.
timeline.quote: Instead of chasing the young and confused Planeswalker off the plane, Sorin decided to mentor Nahiri

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
timeline.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri binds Ob Nixilis's power with a hedron before he can do much damage.
timeline.quote: Nahiri intervened and bound his power with that of a hedron

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine at the hedron nexus, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri wakes, calls unanswered for help and restores it alone.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own in restoring the prison.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri intercepts Ob Nixilis on Zendikar and fuses a hedron into his forehead, binding his spark and trapping him.
timeline.quote: This hedron bound his spark , trapping him on the plane

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin allies with Nahiri and Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers imprisoned them

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri threatens Sorin after he admits her call for help was absorbed by the Helvault; he banishes her into it.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri lure and imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar for 6,000 years.
timeline.quote: The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi caused the three Titans to become trapped in the plane for 6,000 years.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with leylines and hedrons.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers activate the hedron network at the Eye of Ugin, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reinforces the prison on her own and leaves; the vampires are freed of Ulamog's yoke.
timeline.quote: After Nahiri enforced the Eldrazi prison all on her own, no more broods came to life.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri enforces the Eldrazi prison alone, freeing the vampires from Ulamog's yoke.
timeline.quote: The vampires remained, now free of Ulamog's yoke.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "The Bloodchiefs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Three decide to trap the Eldrazi on a plane and choose Nahiri's Zendikar for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana.
timeline.quote: They decided on Nahiri's own Zendikar .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic, and Nahiri builds the hedron network that forms their prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sacrifices herself, exploding the Coliseum onto the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: With a mighty magical blast, she exploded the Coliseum and dropped it with all remaining planeswalkers on the Fair Basilica .

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri cleaves Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Since Nahiri cleaved it from the Dross Pits , Sheoldred's Coliseum now rests in this layer.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gisa befriends Nahiri and provides ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.
timeline.quote: She found a new friend in the lithomancer Nahiri and provided the ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels drew malevolent beings, including Nahiri, into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the Helvault also contained Nahiri

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's magic tears Markov Manor from its mountain perch.
timeline.quote: torn from its mountain perch and left floating above Stensia by Nahiri 's magic.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rescuing Maeli, Avacyn is hit by a strange spell that fills her with disgust toward humans.
timeline.quote: This event, combined with foreign thoughts, caused Avacyn to feel a new sense of disgust toward humans.

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's madness is revealed to be caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Avacyn's madness was caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul to the plane

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freed from the Helvault, Nahiri finds Zendikar ravaged, swears vengeance on Sorin and destroys Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's cryptoliths, powered by Innistrad's leylines, summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.
timeline.quote: These cryptholiths also caused multiple angels

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
timeline.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri wounds and encases Sorin in stone at Markov Manor and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was wounded severely but managed to encase Sorin in stone.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years earlier, Nahiri seeks Sorin's aid; provoked, he has Avacyn imprison her in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the resulting confrontation led to Nahiri’s imprisonment within the vault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, embittered, planeswalks to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away to her home world of Zendikar

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The transformation is mostly reversed when Avacyn is corrupted through Nahiri's machinations.
timeline.quote: The transformation was mostly reversed when Avacyn was corrupted through the machinations of Nahiri

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Wolfir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises a stone rampart around a refugee camp, though she knows it will not hold against the monstrous creatures overrunning the plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, called the Lithomancer, surveyed her work and frowned.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin urges Nahiri to leave the refugees and focus on stopping the creatures before they spread to other worlds; Nahiri insists they are there to save the people.
timeline.quote: I'm here to stop these creatures, on this world, before they spread to others—to mine, or to yours.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin admits that they are not winning against the creatures.
timeline.quote: No," he said.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri melts stone with an old spell and draws out a sword for Lian, telling her the world is hers to fight for.
timeline.quote: She pulled, and an elegant blade slid free of the molten rock.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
timeline.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin flashes away and Lian is taken by the light; Nahiri grabs the sword and planeswalks off the dying world.
timeline.quote: Silently cursing herself, Nahiri grabbed the sword and left the world behind.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains he chose Zendikar because it has a protector, and asks for Nahiri's help rather than forcing her.
timeline.quote: No," said Ugin. "Because I also need your help.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
timeline.quote: My work is just beginning.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin traps the Eldrazi on Zendikar, learning little from Sorin but the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin

citation.text: Ugin's Construct (Ugin's Fate, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
timeline.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
timeline.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi stirred. Nahiri woke.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri recalls living among the kor for centuries, teaching lithomancy and training them to guard the prison, before withdrawing in apathy to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: She had trained the kor to keep watch over the Eldrazi prison

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Zendikar breaks open; Nahiri senses the Eldrazi prison has been opened.
timeline.quote: the prison of the Eldrazi. It was open.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri crushes Eldrazi with an avalanche, then enters a ruined kor city in Ondu and remembers her old life.
timeline.quote: sent an avalanche to crush the abominations

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds a carving of herself with a Kozilek-like figure named 'Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib', and collapses the building, blaming herself for calling Kozilek a god.
timeline.quote: "Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib."

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
timeline.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Near the Eye of Ugin, Nahiri finds a spiked stone building where the hedron network was disturbed and is furious.
timeline.quote: Even as she approached, she could tell that this was the point where the hedron network had been disturbed.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fights and kills vampires at the building with a glowing-hot sword.
timeline.quote: her glowing sword cut through cold flesh

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, holding off more vampires and Eldrazi while she works alone.
timeline.quote: and brought the walls down on them, then returned to her work.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri completes the hedron and repairs the Eldrazi prison, driving the titans back into torpor.
timeline.quote: to link up the broken lines of the hedron network and repair the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
timeline.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Nissa releases the Titans, Emrakul vanishes and is drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, who wants revenge on Sorin.
timeline.quote: She was drawn through the Blind Eternities to the plane of Innistrad by the planeswalker Nahiri

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
timeline.quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits Markov Manor and sends Sorin a clear message.
timeline.quote: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

citation.text: Declaration in Stone (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows to take everything from Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you.

citation.text: Nahiri's Machinations (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri compares Zendikar's bleeding to what Innistrad and Sorin will suffer.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.

citation.text: Structural Distortion (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri twists stone gargoyles to her will.
timeline.quote: Nahiri twisted them in shape and bent them to her will.

citation.text: Stonewing Antagonizer (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana is angered by Nahiri's provocation.
timeline.quote: You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded.

citation.text: Merciless Resolve (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's machinations drive Avacyn and most angels insane, fragmenting the Church.
timeline.quote: Due to Nahiri 's machinations, Avacyn and most other angels became insane and began killing the people of Innistrad.

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Lunarch Inquisition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin; Avacyn and the angels go mad, and Emrakul corrupts inhabitants.
timeline.quote: She was summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri to take revenge on Sorin, and her presence drove Avacyn and the angels to madness.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin recruits Olivia against Nahiri; she requires that he kill Avacyn, and they raise a vampire army.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Olivia assembled a vampire army and went to war against Nahiri.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia proclaims herself lord of Innistrad and takes his sword.
timeline.quote: Olivia proclaimed herself the new lord of Innistrad and took his sword from him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin searches for the whereabouts of Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, Sorin is in search of the whereabouts of Nahiri

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
timeline.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
timeline.quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
timeline.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: After resealing the Eldrazi, Nahiri travels through the Blind Eternities to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri cast herself through the chaos of the Blind Eternities, the space between worlds.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
timeline.quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
timeline.quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
timeline.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
timeline.quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
timeline.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
timeline.quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
timeline.quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
timeline.quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees the vengeful cloud mass from Nephalia tipping toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: the atmospheric mass shifted slowly from its origin over the Nephalia coast, tipping toward Gavony province and the brightly lit High City.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin.
timeline.quote: They called her the Harbinger.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
timeline.quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
timeline.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
timeline.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges four more stone blades from white-hot stones.
timeline.quote: four blades, identical to the one she wielded, each one pulsing with energy of their stone forge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
timeline.quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
timeline.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
timeline.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
timeline.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
timeline.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
timeline.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
timeline.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri called Emrakul across the Blind Eternities and she arrived on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

citation.text: Coax from the Blind Eternities (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor, burning with hatred for Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Burning with hatred for Nahiri, the Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor

citation.text: Bold Impaler (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin, blaming him for what he brought on himself.
timeline.quote: You brought this upon yourself, Sorin!

citation.text: Nahiri's Wrath (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: When Nahiri draws Emrakul to Innistrad, most of her spawn stay on Zendikar and Emrakul corrupts native Innistrad creatures into mutated spawn.
timeline.quote: When Emrakul was drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, most of her spawns were left on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi/Lineages", section "Emrakul's Lineage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has summoned Emrakul to the plane, to take revenge on Sorin Markov .

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: several fishermen found themselves fused to their prey

citation.text: "Fish", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad as Sorin realizes he played into Nahiri's plan.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.
timeline.quote: The Markov suffered great losses when the lithomancer Nahiri destroyed Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "The Four Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri coerces Ral Zarek into returning the icy prison to Dominaria, freeing Marit Lage after sixteen centuries.
timeline.quote: freeing Lage for the first time in sixteen centuries.

citation.text: "Marit Lage", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi are imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin , and Nahiri .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Nahiri battle across Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The ancient Planeswalkers Sorin and Nahiri battled across Ravnica, their blows cutting as deep as their grudge.

citation.text: Nahiri's Stoneblades (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri is trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun and fights Sorin before a temporary truce against the Eternals.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Nahiri fight in single combat, then ally temporarily against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: they later came to a temporary truce, joining forces against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri and revitalizes Zendikar.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.
